description: Editorial metadata of a segment. Fields that are not listed here are ignored by `PUT`.

onScreenText.description: True when the segment is text shown in the video rather than speech. On-screen text uses the speaker `On Screen Text`, is placed by `cue_settings` (the top centre when none is sent), is never dubbed and may overlap other segments.

autoPlaced.description: True when Studio moved this subtitle automatically so it does not cover on-screen text. Resetting the position in the editor clears it.

detectedStyle.description: How the video analysis saw an on-screen text drawn (font, size, colors, background). Studio's editor returns the segment's `style` to it on reset. Send it back unchanged; it is not an override and does not affect rendering.
